title: Tell HMRC about a gift or other transfers of value in a trust (IHT100a)
text:
Use form IHT100a to tell HMRC that Inheritance Tax is due on a trust.

 Find older versions of this form on the National Archives .

 How to complete the form

 You need to:

 • Download and save the form on your computer.

 • Open it using the latest free version of Adobe Reader .

 • Complete it on-screen. The form may not work if you try to open it in your internet browser. If the form does not open, contact online services support for more help .
changeNote: The 'Declaration' and ‘If you’re an agent’ section within 'How to fill in form IHT100a' has been updated as the page numbers are no longer required.
